title: Kano Showcase manifest (showcase.json)
description: Binds a viewer build and a world file into one identified showcase. Shipped inside each release bundle.

showcase_version.description: Semantic version of this showcase release.

world_id.description: Authoritative identity: sha256 of the exact distributed world bytes.

world_file.description: Filename of the world beside the executable.

s9_version.description: On-disk .s9 format version the world was baked at.

params_hash.description: Informational, non-reversible identifier of the generation configuration.

viewer_build.description: Opaque build identifier of the Hikoi binary.

daemon_build.description: Opaque build identifier of the kano binary.

showcase_utsc.description: Pinned world-clock tick for the showcase (freezes weather, light, and season so every viewer and screenshot agrees).
